mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY order_num
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE type != 2 ORDER BY order_num
SELECT m.menu_id FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
